name: Fear of the Lord
overview: The fear of the Lord is a profound reverence rooted in the holiness and authority of God, as demonstrated when the people were commanded to keep a strict boundary around Mount Sinai under threat of death (Exodus 19:12-13). The overwhelming display of God's power through thunder, lightning, and smoke caused the people to stand afar off in awe, expressing a deep respect mixed with fear (Exodus 20:18-19). Moses reassures them that this fear is intended to prevent sin and cultivate a reverent heart before God (Exodus 20:20), highlighting that fear of the Lord is not mere terror but a holy reverence that leads to obedience and spiritual life.
